description: Local AI desktop app: a Chromium browser with a GPU-aware llama.cpp runtime, OpenAI-compatible API, AI chat and agents, Stable Diffusion image/video, TTS and music, plus an MCP server so Claude Code, Codex and Cline can drive your browser. Windows, macOS, Linux.
